name: When should I consider evaluating my existing roof framing, especially before a major remodel?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider evaluating my existing roof framing, especially before a major remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider evaluating your existing roof framing before any major remodel, particularly for projects involving significant structural changes like adding a second story, vaulting ceilings, or expanding your home. An evaluation will identify potential weaknesses, water damage, or outdated construction that may not support new loads or designs. This assessment is a crucial preparatory step. AKN Design Group includes a thorough structural review in our initial design phase for whole-home remodels or additions, allowing us to proactively address any issues and integrate necessary framing enhancements into the renovation plan, preventing costly surprises down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Evaluate existing roof framing before major remodels or additions to identify weaknesses or outdated construction, a crucial step AKN Design Group includes in initial design.
